Pakistan-mediated negotiations produced the framework after repeated short-term ceasefire extensions since the initial April 8 truce. Iranian officials have signaled broad alignment on the text while noting remaining implementation details, and the US has begun lifting associated naval restrictions. These verified diplomatic steps, alongside prior threats of renewed strikes and shipping disruptions, shape trader assessments of near-term US announcements on agreements or extensions.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.
